title: PsyWorld: Profile-Conditioned World Modeling for Human Behavior Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Understanding how stable psychometric traits and time-varying states jointly inform behavior is an important problem in computational behavioral science. Existing personalized agents commonly condition actions directly on a static profile, leaving realized state transitions unused as an explicit source of supervision. We introduce a profile-conditioned state world model that uses observed environment--behavior state transitions to learn transition-informed representations for behavioral prediction. During training, a posterior encoder quantizes realized transitions, while a prior predicts the resulting codes from the psychometric profile and pre-transition context. The prior code and predicted next state then condition macro-level behavior and simulator-grounded execution. translated_title: PsyWorld：面向人类行为预测的画像条件化世界模型
translated_abstract: 理解稳定的心理测量特质与随时间变化的状态如何共同影响行为，是计算行为科学中的一个重要问题。现有的个性化智能体通常直接基于静态画像对动作进行条件化，而未将实际发生的状态转移作为显式的监督信号来源加以利用。我们提出了一种画像条件化的状态世界模型，利用观测到的环境—行为状态转移来学习融合转移信息的行为预测表示。在训练过程中，后验编码器对实际发生的状态转移进行量化，而先验模型则根据心理测量画像和转移前上下文预测相应的编码。随后，先验编码与预测的下一状态共同用于条件化宏观层面的行为以及基于模拟器的行为执行。由此，该世界模型提供了结构化的转移监督，而不是将人格直接作为动作的描述符。我们在VEET（一个协同……）中对所提出的框架进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出PsyWorld，一种画像条件化的状态世界模型，将实际观测到的环境—行为状态转移作为结构化监督信号来学习行为表示，从而摆脱了传统上直接将静态人格画像映射为动作的做法，实现了更准确的人类行为预测。
en_tdlr: PsyWorld is a profile-conditioned state world model that uses realized environment-behavior state transitions as structured supervision to learn transition-informed representations for human behavior prediction, moving beyond directly conditioning actions on static personality profiles.
